locations.label: Temple Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Creator map text places Pack-a-Punch in Temple. Use portal objectives to remove barriers into Merchant Road, East Spring, West Spring and Debris Field. Collect free first-tier perk drinks and prepare weapon, armour and artifact upgrades between objectives. This objective-based map opens areas through portals; The Archon uses a different round-based progression. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Trapped Decimator Shield
locations.description: After opening Merchant Road, approach the trapped Decimator Shield to begin its conversation. Open East Spring, then use the rune stone in the Tents area by Demonic Frenzy. Wait for the dialogue to finish and the portal to appear behind the stone. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Tents rune stone
locations.description: After opening Merchant Road, approach the trapped Decimator Shield to begin its conversation. Open East Spring, then use the rune stone in the Tents area by Demonic Frenzy. Wait for the dialogue to finish and the portal to appear behind the stone. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Bazaar rune stone
locations.description: Return to the shield for its next conversation. Open West Spring and use the Bazaar rune stone below Diabolical Damage. Wait for the new portal beside it, then enter. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Debris Field Void rune
locations.description: Open Debris Field and use its rune stone near Venomous Vigor. Wait for the conversation and enter THIS new Void portal; it is separate from the earlier shield portals. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Lost Pages barrier
locations.description: Dig up four Lost Tome pages in Eastern Desert. Take them to the magical barrier on the small Outpost Courtyard building. Its four attachment positions are Top, Bottom, Left and Right. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Merchant Road antenna radio
locations.description: Dig up a radio antenna and install it on Merchant Road’s radio beside the armoured vehicle. Defeat the spawned Boom-Schreiers. Continue through the two intermediate radios: Bazaar’s Diabolical Damage room and the radio beside Venomous Vigor. The sources list these two in opposite orders; follow whichever is currently interactable, finish its enemies, then check the other. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
